name: D1Bound5.finitePDividedMatrix_det
original_signature:
(a b s c : R) :

name: D1Bound5.finitePMatrix_det
original_signature:
(a b s c : R) :
    (finitePMatrix a b s c).det =
      -78750*a^2*b^2*s^2*(a-b)^5*(a-s)*(b-s)*finitePDetFactor a b s c

name: D1Bound5.finiteP_factor_identity
original_signature:
{R : Type*} [CommRing R] (a b s : R) :
    (a-b)^2 = 4*finitePLeadingFactor a b s-(6*s+a+b)*finitePLinearFactor a b s

name: D1Bound5.map_finitePLeadingFactor
original_signature:
{R S : Type*} [CommRing R] [CommRing S]
    (f : R →+* S) (a b s : R) :
    f (finitePLeadingFactor a b s) = finitePLeadingFactor (f a) (f b) (f s)

name: D1Bound5.finitePRootColumn_coeff
original_signature:
{R : Type*} [CommRing R]
    (a b s c : R) (i : Fin 4) (j : Fin 3) :
    finitePRootColumn a b s c i j = finitePRootCoeff a b s i 0 j +
      finitePRootCoeff a b s i 1 j*c+finitePRootCoeff a b s i 2 j*c^2
explicit_arguments: a b s c i j

name: D1Bound5.finiteP_monomial_le
original_signature:
(A B S : ℝ) (hA : 1 ≤ A)

    (hexp : (i+j+l ≤ 5 ∧ l ≤ 2) ∨ (i+j ≤ 1 ∧ l ≤ 3)) :
    A^i*B^j*S^l ≤ max (B*S^3) (B^3*S^2)
explicit_arguments: A B S hA hAB hBS i j l hexp

name: D1Bound5.finitePRootTerms_sums
original_signature:

    (∑ j, ∑ t, |((finitePRootTerms i 2 j t).1 : ℝ)|) ≤ 2352
